_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): Bran in the village if spared (hub_bran): rebuilding what he burned. S6 (docs/gameplay/23 §8): "How are things?" changes with the story (news_*: the latest chapter done).

text.zh_TW: 布蘭一個人在重建燒掉的房子，滿身是灰。村民們遠遠地看著他，還沒有人跟他說話。他看見你，停下手：「……一間一間來。」
text.en: Bran is rebuilding the burned houses alone, covered in ash. The villagers watch him from a distance. Nobody has spoken to him yet. He sees you and stops. "...One house at a time."

text.zh_TW: 布蘭：「今天有人跟我說了早安。第一個。」他沒有抬頭，繼續釘木板。
text.en: Bran: "Someone said good morning to me today. The first one." He doesn't look up, and keeps nailing boards.

text.zh_TW: 布蘭：「你娘……她來看我了。她什麼都沒說，只是把燉肉放在門口。」他的聲音啞了。
text.en: Bran: "Your mother... she came to see me. She didn't say anything. She just left some stew at the door." His voice cracks.
